question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
-- Final answer with rounding
WITH all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id 
    FROM customer_transactions
),
all_months AS (
    SELECT '2020-01' as month UNION ALL SELECT '2020-02' UNION ALL SELECT '2020-03' UNION ALL SELECT '2020-04'
),
customer_months AS (
    SELECT * FROM all_customers CROSS JOIN all_months
),
monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
        customer_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) - 
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
    GROUP BY substr(txn_date, 1, 7), customer_id
),
customer_month_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.month,
        cm.customer_id,
        COALESCE(mb.month_end_balance, 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_months cm
    LEFT JOIN monthly_balances mb ON cm.month = mb.month AND cm.customer_id = mb.customer_id
),
monthly_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_count,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM customer_month_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        positive_count,
        avg_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) as highest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) as lowest_rank
    FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked_months WHERE highest_rank = 1) - 
        (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked_months WHERE lowest_rank = 1),
        2
    ) as difference
FROM ranked_months
LIMIT 1
